name: William Bannister
story: William Bannister of the Department of Conservation co-presented DOC’s response to the 2017 Port Hills fire at the New Zealand Esri User Conference. The presentation provides another named example of conservation GIS staff moving into emergency-response mapping when an incident crossed normal organisational boundaries.
